### Appointments

<div class="cv-entry">
<div class="cv-head"><span class="cv-role">Director, Halter Ranch Conservation Scholars (HARCS) Program</span><span class="cv-date">Dec. 2025–present</span></div>
<div class="cv-org">Department of Biological Sciences, Cal Poly, San Luis Obispo</div>

- Designed and now direct a conservation training program funded by a $200,000+ industry gift, pairing a quarter of Cal Poly coursework with a paid summer internship at a partner conservation organization.
- Recruited and manage a partner network spanning land trusts, tribal co-managers, state agencies, and private landowners; negotiate project scopes and student placements.
- Lead the associated seminar and mentor scholars on independent field projects; first cohort (seven students, 2026) completed projects on beaver dam analog restoration, virtual fencing, rangeland monitoring, fuels treatment, and wildlife inventory.
- Manage program budget, donor relations, and expansion, including active discussions with additional agricultural partners and an individual-giving channel.

</div>

### Technical and research expertise

<div class="cv-skill">
<span class="cv-skill-name">Landscape-scale spatial analysis.</span> R, Python, Google Earth Engine, and ArcGIS Pro pipelines for processing remote sensing and other spatial data at landscape and statewide extents; statistical treatment of spatial autocorrelation and interpolation of discrete data sources.
</div>

<div class="cv-skill">
<span class="cv-skill-name">Biophysical modeling.</span> Large-scale modeling of biophysical processes, including wind velocity using NOAA's High-Resolution Rapid Refresh atmospheric model with WindNinja, and streamflow using high-resolution digital elevation models and hydrologic models implemented in R.
</div>

<div class="cv-skill">
<span class="cv-skill-name">Biological inventory and monitoring.</span> Design and implementation of field data collection and processing for inventory and monitoring: mobile data platforms in Esri Field Maps and Survey123; rare and invasive plant mapping; meadow and rangeland monitoring design; herbarium voucher collection and curation; iNaturalist projects for crowdsourced data; camera trapping and AI-assisted identification (Addax AI, Wildlife Insights).
</div>

<div class="cv-skill">
<span class="cv-skill-name">Data science and computing.</span> High-performance computing clusters and parallel processing; analysis of biodiversity datasets of millions of records to produce diversity statistics, range maps, and species interaction networks; reproducible workflows in R and Python, version control with Git.
</div>

<div class="cv-skill">
<span class="cv-skill-name">Genomics and bioinformatics.</span> Target capture, RAD-seq, and whole-genome resequencing analysis in HPC environments; phylogenomic and population genomic inference, species delimitation, and hybridization analysis.
</div>
